source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: An agent can read your project but lacks permission to modify it. It proposes a useful edit. What follows?

options.text: The read permission also permits the proposed modification
options.feedback: Reading and changing files require the relevant access. The scenario explicitly says the agent lacks permission to modify the project.

options.text: The suggestion does not change the project file
options.feedback: A model can describe a useful edit without executing it. Reading access and a proposal do not establish a completed modification.

options.text: The value of the edit supplies the missing permission
options.feedback: A model's judgment that an action is useful does not grant write access. The surrounding controls determine permitted execution.

options.text: The skill can write the edit using its instructions
options.feedback: The skill can guide an editing procedure. Its instructions do not perform the file operation or supply the missing write permission.
